newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein stable in quiet late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein stable in quiet late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were generally stable in late trading on Wednesday on thin buying interest, traders said.
They said palm olein was quoted at 1,410 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening, but offers were also heard at 1,415 rupiah.
Crude palm oil was done at 1,246.61 rupiah/kg exBelawan port in the North Sumatran city of Medan at a 500-tonne tender.
"The market was slow, with buyers mostly sidelined," one trader said. "Consumer demand that emerged ahead of the Eid al-Adha celebration on Friday petered out."
The traders said export prices were comparatively better than local values and sellers preferred to export their oil instead of selling locally.
Data from Belawan Port showed that the MT Chariot will leave the North Sumatran port on Friday for Port Klang, Malaysia, with 12,455 tonnes of crude palm oil.
